facts.text: Fostoria is known for its glass heritage and railroads: two CSX main lines and one NS main line intersect in downtown Fostoria, an area called the 'Iron Triangle.'.
Fostoria was a major site for the glass industry, having over a dozen glass factories during the end of the 19th century.
The Historical Society seeks to promote an appreciation of Fostoria’s heritage through the collection of local artifacts and the dissemination of historical knowledge to the public.
Fostoria is a city located at the convergence of Hancock, Seneca, and Wood counties in the northwestern part of the U.S.
Fostoria was created in 1854 with the merger of the communities of Rome and Risdon.
